# Lending Policy Review and Risk Assessment

This document addresses critical areas within the lending policy requiring immediate attention.

## Key Investigation Areas:

*   Investigate the default risk standard update.
*   Urgently investigate the borrower credit score.
*   Urgently investigate the interest rates.
*   Investigate the borrower credit score standard update.
*   Review the default risk standard update.
